notes: Account overview: large fintech analytics platform; model-powered risk alerts + trader-facing summaries. Primary constraint is network security and data residency. They cannot allow inference VMs to have broad internet egress; security policy requires outbound egress only through approved proxies and IP ranges. Prefer PrivateLink over VPC peering to avoid transitive routing and to limit blast radius. Key asks: 1) PrivateLink/VPC Endpoint architecture guidance and template CloudFormation/Terraform snippets; 2) Firewall rules: only 443 outbound from inference subnets, no ephemeral port openings, strict SGs and NACLs; 3) Egress controls: NAT/proxy design, allowlist destination IPs for upstream model routing when routing to Redwood hosted fallback; 4) IP allowlists: they will provide list for corporate IPs and SIEM ingest endpoints; 5) Audit logging: retention 7 years, must forward to their Splunk/Datadog via private endpoints or VPC flow logs to S3 + KMS-encrypted; 6) KMS: BYOK required for storage and model cache encryption, HSM/FIPS requirement on key storage, integration details needed (CMK import vs AWS KMS multi-account grants); 7) Data residency: EU and NA tenancy separation for backups/snapshots; 8) SSO: SAML + SCIM provisioning for console access; 9) Monitoring: syslog/CloudWatch integration and ability to push structured audit logs to cust SIEM.
poC_requirements: 2-week lab POC: baseline traffic sim - 100 qps reads (embeddings + rerank), 20 qps writes; latency SLO target p95 < 250ms for small-model routes, p95 < 600ms for larger model; cost telemetry and hashable audit logs required. POC deliverables: runbook, architecture diagram, test harness, latency/cost report.
network_preferences: PrivateLink preferred; if peering used must provide explicit routing table design (no transitive peering). Prefer internal ALB in private subnet in front of inference nodes; Egress via centralized NAT/proxy with allowlist; EKS workers -> inference VPC via VPC endpoint.
